changeSet.sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT message_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY conversation_id ORDER BY created_at, message_id) AS sequence_no FROM ai_message ) UPDATE ai_message SET sequence_no = (SELECT ranked.sequence_no FROM ranked WHERE ranked.message_id = ai_message.message_id)

UPDATE ai_message AS target JOIN ( SELECT message_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY conversation_id ORDER BY created_at, message_id) AS sequence_no FROM ai_message ) AS ranked ON ranked.message_id = target.message_id SET target.sequence_no = ranked.sequence_no

MERGE INTO ai_message target USING ( SELECT message_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY conversation_id ORDER BY created_at, message_id) AS sequence_no FROM ai_message ) ranked ON (ranked.message_id = target.message_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.sequence_no = ranked.sequence_no WHERE target.sequence_no = 0
